    SELECT year, driver_id, first_round AS round_num FROM drives WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    UNION

),
distinct_rounds AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT round_num) AS num_rounds
    FROM all_rounds
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round_num) >= 2
),
season_first AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round
    FROM drives WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959 AND is_first_drive_of_season = '1'
),
season_last AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, last_round
    FROM drives WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959 AND is_final_drive_of_season = '1'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT f.year, f.driver_id, f.constructor_id AS first_constructor, l.constructor_id AS last_constructor
    FROM season_first f JOIN season_last l ON f.year = l.year AND f.driver_id = l.driver_id
